debug_enabled.description: Turn on debugging output. May reveal sensitive information like entered pass phrase.

enhanced_mode.description: Ask for timeouts and insurance, too. Currently not fully supported.

no_global_grab.description: Grab the keyboard only when the window is focused. Use if debugging software using pinentry-x2go.

parent_wid.description: Use window ID N as the parent window for positioning the window.

display.description: Display string passed to pinentry-qt for localization.

ttyname.description: TTY name passed to pinentry-qt for localization.

ttytype.description: TTY type passed to pinentry-qt for localization.

lc_type.description: LC_TYPE passed to pinentry-qt for localization.

lc_messages.description: LC_MESSAGES passed to pinentry-qt for localization.
